text:
ops-bot: ALERT: metering-ingest queue stalled for shard-7 — lag > 45m, missing events since 2026-03-15T02:12Z
maya: noticed billing dashboard shows ~18% lower token count for 2026-03-15; several customers opened escalations about invoice totals.
ops-bot: alert generated by ingest-monitor (rule: ingest_lag > 30m)
sam: picking this up. checking consumer status for shard-7 now.
sam: ```
$ ./consumerctl status --shard 7
state: paused
lag: 278000 events
last_offset: 3421891
consumer_pid: 22345 (exited)
```
ahmed: logs show OOM kill on the consumer process, then failed checkpoint writes. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:11:52Z ERROR consumer[22345] OOMKilled: process terminated
2026-03-15T02:12:04Z WARN consumer[22346] failed to write checkpoint: errno=28 ENOSPC
```
julia: billing — placing a hold on tonight's auto-invoice run for impacted accounts. @billing-bot can you list affected invoices/accounts?
billing-bot: flagged accounts: acct-A123, acct-B456, acct-C789 — holding invoice generation for those until reconciliation complete. added ticket BK-7892.
maya: can we run an event replay to fill the gap? want to avoid overloading downstream write paths.
sam: agreed. plan: replay shard-7 only, run with dedupe + throttle. recommended command:
```
./event-replay --from-offset 3421891 --to-latest --shard 7 --dedupe --throttle 500 --checkpoints ./replay-checkpoints/shard7.json
```
ahmed: before replay I'll run a checksum compare for the date window to quantify delta.
ahmed: ```
$ ./reconcile-usage --range 2026-03-14T00:00Z:2026-03-16T00:00Z --shard 7 --mode=checksum
OUT: expected_tokens=1234567 actual_tokens=1050123 delta=-183444
```
sam: started replay at 2026-03-16T03:20Z, 4 workers, throttle=500rps. monitoring.
maya: adding watch on cost and latency dashboards, ping me if any write spikes.
eva: I've informed the two impacted customers with a short note: 'we detected an ingestion delay; running backfill; will update when reconciled.'
sam: replay progress: 45k events processed, 2.4k duplicates dropped by dedupe filter, current lag decreasing.
ahmed: re-ran checksum after partial replay:
```
OUT: expected_tokens=1234567 actual_tokens=1178900 delta=-55367
```
julia: good — partial fill reduced delta to ~4.5%. billing-bot: holding invoices until delta < 0.5% or manual sign-off.
sam: continuing replay, throttling down to 300rps overnight to ease DB pressure.
ops-bot: ALERT: ingest_lag for shard-7 cleared (lag < 10m).
maya: confirmed reconciliation run scheduled; final checksum to run at 2026-03-16T08:00Z.
ahmed: final checksum output:
```
OUT: expected_tokens=1234567 actual_tokens=1234700 delta=+132
```
julia: closing hold on affected invoices, billing team to regenerate and send updated statements. julia: I'll post customer follow-up template in #support-comm.
maya: action items:
- add alert: consumer-restart-loop (increase severity)
- bump eventstore retention for shard logs by 7d
- add automatic 'hold invoices' hook when ingest_lag > 30m
- write runbook for shard-level replay with dedupe and throttle
sam: will open PR for replay tool to add progress metrics and safe-default throttle.
eva: noted. customer comms will go out after billing confirms regenerated invoices. :thumbsup: 
julia: thanks everyone, filing a brief incident note and scheduling a postmortem tomorrow.
ops-bot: incident ticket INC-2026-340 created, severity=medium, owner=maya
